intro: The Vial of Purest Water is a sacred vessel blessed by the hermit Brine deep in the southern Barrens. Entrusted to an initiate shaman, its purified contents are essential for concocting the draught required to perceive elusive elemental spirits.

p: Forged through trials of patience and cleansing under the guidance of Brine, the water sealed in this vial represents liquid in its uncorrupted elemental essence. Transported across the arid wastes of the Barrens back to the solitary shore where Islen Waterseer keeps watch, the vial serves as the vital component in brewing a water sapta. Without its pristine purity, a shaman cannot commune with the spiritual guardians that dwell in places far removed from the sunbaked flats.
